mapper.sql: select p.post_id, p.publisher_id, p.post_type, p.lifecycle_status, p.review_status, p.title, p.description, p.item_category_id, p.color_category_id, p.campus_category_id, p.area_category_id, p.location_detail, p.event_date, p.expire_time, p.view_count, p.version, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, p.del_flag, item.category_name as item_category_name, color.category_name as color_category_name, campus.category_name as campus_category_name, area.category_name as area_category_name from lf_post p left join lf_category item on item.category_id = p.item_category_id left join lf_category color on color.category_id = p.color_category_id left join lf_category campus on campus.category_id = p.campus_category_id left join lf_category area on area.category_id = p.area_category_id

sql.if: and (p.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
p.lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' and p.review_status = 'APPROVED' and p.del_flag = '0'
order by p.create_time desc, p.post_id desc
where p.post_id = #{postId} and p.lifecycle_status in ('PUBLISHED', 'RESOLVED') and p.review_status = 'APPROVED' and p.del_flag = '0'
where p.lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' and p.review_status = 'APPROVED' and p.expire_time is not null and p.expire_time <= sysdate() and p.del_flag = '0' order by p.expire_time, p.post_id
mapper.insert: insert into lf_post ( publisher_id, post_type, lifecycle_status, review_status, title, description, item_category_id, color_category_id, campus_category_id, area_category_id, location_detail, event_date, expire_time, view_count, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, del_flag ) values ( #{publisherId}, #{postType}, #{lifecycleStatus}, #{reviewStatus}, #{title}, #{description}, #{itemCategoryId}, #{colorCategoryId}, #{campusCategoryId}, #{areaCategoryId}, #{locationDetail}, #{eventDate}, #{expireTime}, #{viewCount}, #{version}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, '0' )
mapper.update:
update lf_post
post_type = #{postType}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, item_category_id = #{itemCategoryId}, color_category_id = #{colorCategoryId}, campus_category_id = #{campusCategoryId}, area_category_id = #{areaCategoryId}, location_detail = #{locationDetail}, event_date = #{eventDate}, expire_time = #{expireTime}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate()
where post_id = #{postId} and publisher_id = #{publisherId} and version = #{version} and lifecycle_status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED') and del_flag = '0'

update lf_post set lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, review_status = #{reviewStatus}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where post_id = #{postId} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
update lf_post set view_count = view_count + 1 where post_id = #{postId} and lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' and review_status = 'APPROVED' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select image_id, post_id, object_key, concat('/lostfound/post/', post_id, '/images/', image_id) as access_url, sha256, sort_order, review_status, file_size, mime_type, create_by, create_time, del_flag from lf_post_image where post_id = #{postId} and del_flag = '0' order by sort_order, image_id

select image_id, post_id, object_key, concat('/lostfound/post/', post_id, '/images/', image_id) as access_url, sha256, sort_order, review_status, file_size, mime_type, create_by, create_time, del_flag from lf_post_image where post_id = #{postId} and image_id = #{imageId} and del_flag = '0'

select image_id, post_id, object_key, concat('/lostfound/post/', post_id, '/images/', image_id) as access_url, sha256, sort_order, review_status, file_size, mime_type, create_by, create_time, del_flag from lf_post_image where post_id = #{postId} and sha256 = #{sha256} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(1) from lf_post_image where post_id = #{postId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into lf_post_image ( post_id, object_key, access_url, sha256, sort_order, review_status, file_size, mime_type, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) values ( #{postId}, #{objectKey}, #{accessUrl}, #{sha256}, #{sortOrder}, #{reviewStatus}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), '0' )
mapper.update: update lf_post set lifecycle_status = 'RESOLVED', version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where post_id = #{postId} and version = #{version} and lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' and review_status = 'APPROVED' and del_flag = '0'

update lf_post set lifecycle_status = 'EXPIRED', version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where post_id = #{postId} and version = #{version} and lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' and review_status = 'APPROVED' and expire_time is not null and expire_time <= sysdate() and del_flag = '0'
